messages:
paul_customer: Hi team — after upgrading to @redwood/sdk-node v0.25.0 our calls to client.chat.create return 404. Also our payload field sessionId is being ignored by the API (server expects session_id now?). Repro:

```
const client = new Redwood({ key: process.env.RW_KEY });
await client.chat.create({ model: "gpt-4o", sessionId: "abc", messages: [{ role: "user", content: "hi" }] });
```

curl repro:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/chat.create \
 -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
 -d '{"model":"gpt-4o","sessionId":"abc","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'
```

Response: `404 {"error":"route not found"}`

App started spamming retries and we hit billing alerts.

julie_support: sorry about that — can you confirm org/workspace and full SDK version? also paste first/last req ids if available.

paul_customer: org=acme-inc, sdk=0.25.0, node=18.16.0, req id=rid_9a2bcd. full body above.

julie_support: thanks — forwarding to eng. meanwhile can you try downgrading to 0.24.3: `npm i @redwood/sdk-node@0.24.3` and see? also try raw REST to `POST /v1/chat.sessions.create` (old route) as temporary workaround.

max_eng: digging — we shipped a rename in the generated client for v0.25: `chat.create` was accidentally removed from the published OpenAPI bundle and a param mapping changed `sessionId` -> `session_id` on the client only (server still accepts both). The published SDK used the new client generator flag which dropped the alias. That's why curl with sessionId gets 404 in SDK but raw REST with `chat.sessions.create` works. Repro'd locally.

max_eng: quick repro steps I ran:
```
npm i @redwood/sdk-node@0.25.0
node -e "const c=require('@redwood/sdk-node'); console.log(Object.keys(c.chat || {}))"
# output: ["createSession","list"]  <-- missing create alias
```

max_eng: I'll cut a patch release to reintroduce `chat.create` alias and param aliasing. ETA ~2h. tagging @julie_support for customer comms.

deploy-bot: canary deploy started for patch/restore-alias branch — build 7834 — ETA 25m.

carla_docs: adding migration note to SDK changelog and docs (migration-guide.md) about param renames and how to add compat header.

julie_support: workaround for customer: set header `x-rw-sdk-compat: legacy` in requests or rename `sessionId` -> `session_id` in payload; both worked for them?

paul_customer: confirmed adding header `x-rw-sdk-compat: legacy` fixed responses, no more 404s. thanks.

max_eng: released @redwood/sdk-node@0.25.1 restoring aliases and publishing correct OpenAPI. Please try upgrade to 0.25.1 or keep header until then.

julie_support: perfect. follow-up: will close once customer verifies in prod.

paul_customer: verified 0.25.1 works, thanks everyone :tada:

julie_support: closing thread — filed internal postmortem and changelog entry.
